children: BILL (

the intelligent finance platform trusted by nearly 500,000 businesses to manage, move, and maximize their money, today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by TPG, a leading global alternative asset management firm, in partnership with Corpay (

), the Global Spend Management Company. BILL will be acquired for $63.25 per share in a cash transaction that values BILL at $6.0 billion. TPG will acquire a majority interest in BILL through TPG Capital, the firm’s U.S. and European private equity platform, and Corpay will acquire a minority interest.

The per share purchase price represents a 31% premium to the 60-day volume-weighted average price ending on November 16, the last full trading day preceding media reports that BILL was in acquisition discussions.

“This transaction marks an exciting new chapter for BILL, delivering significant, certain, and immediate value to our stockholders, while creating new opportunities to accelerate our transformation and deliver greater value to customers,” said René Lacerte, CEO and Founder of BILL. “With our new partners, we will have the resources, expertise, and strategic support to accelerate innovation, advance our AI transformation, and continue to drive the future of financial operations. We look forward to the opportunities ahead for our customers and our business.”

“BILL has built a differentiated financial operations platform that helps small and midsize businesses manage their most critical financial workflows. We have long recognized the significant opportunity at the intersection of financial technology, AI, and payments, and believe BILL is well positioned to capitalize on these trends through its scaled network, integrated technology, and deep customer relationships,” said John Flynn, Partner at TPG. “We are excited to partner with the BILL team, combining TPG’s technology investing and business-building experience with Corpay’s payments expertise to accelerate innovation and support the company's next chapter,” added Tim Millikin, Partner at TPG.

“We’re excited about the potential this agreement represents and have great respect for everything the BILL team has accomplished. We see clear opportunities to support and complement BILL’s product roadmap, platform capabilities, and the services it offers to a broader range of customers. We look forward to working with BILL to further enhance its market-leading platform to deliver greater innovation and value to customers,” said Ron Clarke, Chairman and CEO of Corpay.
Transaction Details

The transaction, which was approved unanimously by the BILL Board of Directors, is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions, including approval by BILL stockholders and the receipt of required regulatory approvals. There are no financing conditions to the transaction. Starboard Value, BILL's largest stockholder, and BILL’s CEO and Founder, René Lacerte, have agreed to vote their shares in favor of the agreement.

Upon the close of the transaction, Mr. Lacerte will continue to lead BILL as CEO. BILL will become a privately held company, and its common stock will no longer be listed on any public stock exchange.
Advisors

Goldman Sachs and Qatalyst Partners are serving as financial advisors to BILL, Fenwick & West LLP is serving as BILL’s legal advisor, and Joele Frank, Wilkinson Brimmer Katcher is serving as strategic communications advisor.
BofA Securities, Inc., Deutsche Bank Securities Inc., and RBC Capital Markets, LLC are serving as financial advisors to TPG. Davis Polk & Wardwell LLP is serving as legal counsel.
Barclays is serving as financial adviser to Corpay. Sullivan & Cromwell LLP is serving as legal counsel.
About BILL
BILL (

) is the intelligent finance platform trusted by nearly half a million businesses and their accountants to manage, move, and maximize their money. BILL powers businesses ranging from fast-moving startups to growing companies with complex operations. We use AI to deliver strategic finance capabilities in one integrated platform that includes AP, AR, expenses, forecasting, procurement and more. With a member network of more than 9 million, BILL’s platform processes over 1% of US GDP annually. Headquartered in San Jose, California, BILL is a trusted partner of leading U.S. financial institutions, accounting firms, and software providers. For more information, visit bill.com.
About TPG

TPG is a leading global alternative asset management firm, founded in San Francisco in 1992, with $346 billion of assets under management and investment and operational teams around the world. TPG invests across a broadly diversified set of strategies, including private equity, impact, credit, real estate, and market solutions, and our unique strategy is driven by collaboration, innovation, and inclusion. Our teams combine deep product and sector experience with broad capabilities and expertise to develop differentiated insights and add value for our fund investors, portfolio companies, management teams, and communities.
About Corpay
Corpay (

), the Global Spend Management Company, is an S&P 500 company with three primary B2B solution sets. Spend Management, provides corporate and virtual card programs and AP automation solutions. Cross-Border, helps businesses manage foreign-currency exposure and provides global multi-currency account solutions. Vehicle Solutions, controls fuel, tolls, parking and related vehicle spend. With Corpay, the more a business controls, the less it spends. To learn more, visit corpay.com.

This communication is not a substitute for the Proxy Statement or any other document that BILL may file with the SEC or send to its stockholders in connection with the proposed transaction. Participants in the Solicitation

BILL and its directors, executive officers, other members of its management and employees may be deemed to be participants in the solicitation of proxies of BILL stockholders in connection with the proposed transaction under SEC rules. Investors and stockholders may obtain more detailed information regarding the names, affiliations and interests of BILL’s executive officers and directors in the solicitation by reading BILL’s definitive proxy statement for its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders, the Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 and the subsequent Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q, SEC filings on Forms 3 and 4 by such directors and executive officers and the Proxy Statement and other relevant materials that will be filed with the SEC in connection with the proposed transaction when they become available. Any changes in the holdings of BILL’s securities by its directors or executive officers from the amounts described in BILL’s definitive proxy statement for its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders have been or will be reflected in Statements of Changes in Beneficial Ownership on Form 4 filed with the SEC subsequent to the filing date of BILL’s definitive proxy statement for its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders. Such filings are or will be available on the SEC’s website at www.sec.gov. Information concerning the interests of BILL’s participants in the solicitation, which may, in some cases, be different than those of BILL’s stockholders generally, will be set forth in the Proxy Statement relating to the proposed transaction when it becomes available. Additional information regarding the identity of potential participants, and their direct or indirect interests, by security holdings or otherwise, will be included in the Proxy Statement when it is filed with the SEC. These documents (when available) may be obtained free of charge on BILL’s website at https://investor.bill.com/ or from the SEC’s website at www.sec.gov.
